Ted Piltzecker enjoys an active career as a vibraphonist, composer, educator and promoter of world music. He cites his time with the George Shearing Quintet as one of his most valuable learning experiences.
Ted was interviewed in Clinton, NY on October 10, 2019 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.

My name is Monk Rowe and I’m very happy to have a vibe performance Ted Piltzecker on campus today, and I should say vibes player and educator and composer, arranger, pilot. If you made a pie chart and looked at your career, are the things you do sort of equal in amount?
